name: SAID-NeRF
definition: A method that exploits instance masks generated by Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) to enhance NeRF’s estimation of surfaces of transparent objects that are otherwise ambiguous when relying purely on RGB, via the simultaneous reconstruction of semantic fields and extensions to increase robustness.
summary: SAID-NeRF enhances NeRF for transparent objects by using Visual Foundation Model masks to decompose appearance into diffuse and specular components, yielding sharper depth estimates for robotic grasping.
